I replied to Dana in her DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for **185 seats**.

That figure comes from #north-team, a channel Dana is in. On 20 Aug 2025 she posted that the amendment had been signed the day before and gave the count as 180. A few minutes later she corrected it to 185.

I couldn't open the amendment itself because no Quarrendon account files are visible to her. So I told her the number comes from her correction, not the contract, and that June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if she wants to check before the deck goes out.

A seat count counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so Dana can have it and no approval was needed. There's also a competitor company with a similar name, Quarendon Freightways. I checked that the answer is for the right one, Quarrendon Freight Lines.
